questions.stem: 當學生們開始拍攝時，才發現拍一部短片需要很多耐心與合作。
questions.answer: When the students began shooting, they found that making a short film required a lot of patience and cooperation.
accepted_answers: When the students started filming, they realized that making a short film took a lot of patience and teamwork.
When the students started to shoot the film, they discovered that making a short film needed lots of patience and cooperation.

questions.stem: 除了在校內影展播放，他們的作品也被上傳到網路，讓更多觀眾看到。
questions.answer: Besides being shown at the school film festival, their films were also uploaded online for a larger audience.
accepted_answers: In addition to being shown at the school film festival, their works were also posted online so that more people could see them.
Apart from being shown at the school's film festival, their films were also uploaded to the Internet for more viewers to watch.

1.explanation_zh: 「當學生們開始拍攝時」是時間副詞子句 When + S + V；主要子句「才發現」中文省略主詞，英文要補 they。「拍一部短片需要…」的主詞是動詞片語，英文改成動名詞 making a short film，動詞用單數（required／took）。「耐心」是名詞 patience，不是形容詞 patient。
1.strategy_zh: 中文「才發現」常省略主詞，英文主要子句一定要有主詞；that 子句裡的主詞是動作時，一樣改成 V-ing。
hints: 切成四段：當學生們開始拍攝時／才發現／拍一部短片／需要很多耐心與合作
標的詞彙：student（學生，L1）、shoot（拍攝，L2）、find（發現，L1）、film（影片，L1）、require（需要，L2）、patience（耐心，L3）、cooperation（合作，L4）
句型框架：When + S + V-ed, S + found that + V-ing … + V-ed …

2.explanation_zh: 「除了…之外」用 Besides／In addition to／Apart from，介系詞後面接動名詞；作品是「被播放」的，要寫被動的 being shown。「也被上傳到網路」是過去的被動：were (also) uploaded online，also 放在 be 動詞後面。「讓更多觀眾看到」可以簡潔寫成 for a larger audience，或用 so that more people could see them。
2.strategy_zh: 介系詞後面一律接名詞或 V-ing；主詞是「被…」的時候，動名詞要改成 being + p.p.。
hints: 切成四段：除了在校內影展播放／他們的作品／也被上傳到網路／讓更多觀眾看到
標的詞彙：show（播放，L1）、festival（影展，L1）、film（影片、作品，L1）、upload（上傳，L2）、audience（觀眾，L3）
句型框架：Besides + being p.p. …, S + were also + p.p. …

references: When the students began shooting, they found that making a short film required a lot of patience and cooperation.
When the students started filming, they realized that making a short film took a lot of patience and teamwork.
When the students started to shoot the film, they discovered that making a short film needed lots of patience and cooperation.

common_errors.explanation_zh: begin 後面接 V-ing 或 to + 原形動詞。
後面說「才發現」是過去的事，兩個子句時態要一致，用過去式 began。
「才發現」的主詞是學生們，英文的主要子句不能沒有主詞，要補 they。
這裡的「才」表示「到那時候才」，不是 just（剛剛）；直接用 they found／realized 即可。
「拍一部短片」在 that 子句裡當主詞，要改成動名詞 making a short film。
a 後面接單數名詞 film。

traps.explanation_zh: that 子句的主詞是動作「拍一部短片」，照字面寫 make a short film 當主詞不合文法；要改成動名詞 making …。

traps.explanation_zh: 「耐心」是名詞 patience；patient 是形容詞或「病人」。

bonus.text: Not until the students began shooting did they realize that making a short film required a lot of patience and cooperation.
bonus.explanation_zh: 「…時才發現」可以寫成 Not until … 放句首，主要子句倒裝 did they realize；這是倒裝句，只當加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「拍一部短片需要很多耐心與合作」的主詞是動詞片語，英文要改成動名詞 making a short film 當 that 子句的主詞；「才發現」也要補上主詞 they。

1.translation: When the students started filming, they realized that making a short film requires a lot of patience and cooperation.
1.explanation_zh: 「當…時，才發現」用 When 副詞子句（過去式），「才」不一定要譯成 not until／only then 的倒裝；「拍一部短片」用動名詞 making a short film 當名詞子句的主詞；拍片需要耐心是一般事實，子句用現在式 requires（用 required 也可）。

2.translation: Besides being shown at the school film festival, their works were also uploaded to the Internet so that more viewers could see them.
2.explanation_zh: 「除了在…播放」作品是被播放，用 Besides + being p.p.（介系詞＋動名詞的被動）；「也被上傳到網路」用過去式被動 were uploaded；「讓更多觀眾看到」表目的，用 so that…could。「作品」譯 works（也可譯 films），「播放」也可用 screened，寫法不止一種所以給 medium。

issues_zh: 我在 that 子句用一般現在式 requires：「拍短片需要很多耐心與合作」是普遍事實，主要子句用過去式 realized 之後仍可用現在式（文法正確，學生也常這樣寫）。但三個參考譯文和 P4 accepted 全是過去式 required／took／needed，現在式不在可接受寫法內；建議 P4 accepted 補 requires／takes／needs a lot of patience and cooperation。

problems: 第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義

1.translation: It was only when the students began filming that they realized making a short film requires a great deal of patience and cooperation.
1.explanation_zh: 中文「當……時，才發現」帶有「到那時才」的語氣，用強調句型 It was only when…that…；「發現」用 realized 後接名詞子句，動名詞 making a short film 當子句主詞。

2.translation: Besides being shown at the school film festival, their works were also uploaded to the Internet so that more viewers could see them.
2.explanation_zh: 「除了……之外」用 Besides 加動名詞被動 being shown，主詞 their works 與被動一致；「讓更多觀眾看到」用 so that 目的子句。

issues_zh: （建議，不影響判定）第 4 部分 accepted 全是過去式（required／took／needed），但「拍一部短片需要…」是普遍事實，現在式 requires 同樣正確，建議補現在式與 a great deal of；中文「才發現」帶有「到那時才」的語氣，也可補 It was only when … that … 的強調寫法。

status_reason: blind_solver:A 未通過：第 1 題盲譯的寫法不在可接受寫法內：參考譯文或評分規準太窄（補進 references／parts.accepted），或中文有歧義。判定者（第 1 輪）人工確認：第 1 題評分規準太窄。「拍一部短片需要很多耐心與合作」是普遍事實，盲譯 A 寫 they realized that making a short film requires a lot of patience and cooperation（過去式主要子句接現在式 that 子句，文法正確），B 也指出現在式同樣正確；但三個參考譯文與 P4 accepted 只收過去式 required／took／needed，常見錯誤與解析又強調兩個子句時態要一致，學生寫正確的現在式會被扣分。修正方向：P4 accepted 補 requires／takes／needs a lot of patience and cooperation（可加 a great deal of），解析說明普遍事實可用現在式；B 建議的 It was only when … that … 強調句可列進 bonus。
